steps.label: abandoned hope of reconciliation
steps.quote: In less than a year, most of the delegates abandoned hope of reconciliation with Britain.
steps.orderHint: Early shift made later proposals possible.

steps.label: introduced a resolution
steps.quote: On June 7, 1776, Richard Henry Lee introduced a resolution
steps.orderHint: A proposal is put forward under colony instructions.

steps.label: contained three parts
steps.quote: The Lee Resolution contained three parts: a declaration of independence, a call to form foreign alliances,

steps.label: appointed three concurrent committees
steps.quote: On June 11, 1776, the Congress appointed three concurrent committees in response to the Lee Resolution
steps.orderHint: Work is divided to handle each goal.

steps.label: believed the actions Lee proposed to be premature
steps.quote: Because many members of the Congress believed the actions Lee proposed to be premature or wanted instructions from their colonies before voting,
